end.parentNote: Asha practised using the signs of x and y to identify quadrants, and Harsh correctly used this method for (3, -2) and (-2, 5). They also identified the origin as (0, 0) and outside the quadrants. Harsh mixed up the order in an ordered pair, saying (3, 2) and (2, 3) mark the same point; this was still unresolved at the end. At home, have them plot both points on squared paper and label the horizontal move first, then the vertical move.
